_readme: YouTube Shorts upload metadata for @theaeoloop. One entry per UNIQUE reel (the IG reel-manifest repeats slugs; YouTube uploads each once). The publisher (youtube_publisher.py) matches slug -> the rendered MP4 in REELS_DIR, muxes YOUTUBE_MUSIC, and uploads a public Short. Titles are search-first (<=100 chars); keep #Shorts in the description so YouTube treats vertical clips as Shorts. Rules: no fabricated stats, never guarantee AI rankings, do not disparage SEO.
